Latin word

ācer

ācer, ācris, ācre

adjective, third declension, three endings · Declension on Wiktionary

sharp, keen, fierce; sharp, severe (of winter, pain, hunger); sharp, spicy-hot

In this lexicon

  • intense

    also used · classical · Cic. de Or. 2.183: ācer et vehemēns incitātiō (Lewis & Short, s.v. vehemēns)

  • severe

    the recommended word · classical · Hor. C. 1.4.1: solvitur ācris hiems; Plaut. Men. 5.2.119: morbum ācrem ac dūrum (Lewis & Short)

  • spicy

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 73; M-O s.v. spicy; Traupman 329
